operation.query:
query GetUpdateNotifications {
  updateNotifications {
    ...UpdateNotificationFields
    __typename
  }
}

fragment UpdateNotificationFields on UpdateNotification {
  kind
  sourceId
  name
  repositoryUrl
  defaultBranch
  installedRevision
  latestRevision
  foundAt
  read
  state
  handledRevision
  handledAt
  __typename
}
